name: Lan Yan
notes: The build script found no Game8 page for her (its menu missed the page), so Game8's Lan Yan page (archives/486709) was read by hand on 2026-10-29. Both sources agree on 4pc Viridescent Venerer; the shield-support build uses ATK% or ER sands and ATK% goblet and circlet, the swirl build EM on all three. The card follows the shield build (Game8's 'Shielder Support': 2pc Gladiator's Finale + 2pc Shimenawa's Reminiscence or Viridescent, Memory of Dust best; KQM's off-field shield support: ATK% / ER / EM sands, ATK% or Anemo DMG goblet, ATK% or CRIT circlet, Starcaller's Watch first) and keeps the swirl choices as options. Game8's goals are ATK 2,000 and ER 200+; KQM's ER is 165-210 for triple Anemo off-field with one Elemental Skill hit caught, 215-280 solo. Talent order: Game8 Skill > Burst > Normal Attack, KQM Skill > Burst > character level for the shield build. All her talents use the elemental curve.
